theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} [LinearOrder α] [DenselyOrdered α] {s t : Set α} (hsf : s.Finite) (hs : s.Nonempty) (htf : t.Finite) (ht : t.Nonempty) (H : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ t, x < y) : ∃ b, (∀ x ∈ s, x < b) ∧ ∀ y ∈ t, b < y := by
  let lo := s.Finite.toFinset
  let hi := t.Finite.toFinset
  have lo_nonempty : Nonempty lo := s.Nonempty.toFinset
  have hi_nonempty : Nonempty hi := t.Nonempty.toFinset
  have lo_hi_order : ∀ x ∈ lo, ∀ y ∈ hi, x < y := by
    intro x hx
    intro y hy
    exact H x hx y hy
  apply Order.exists_between_finsets
  exact lo
  exact hi
  exact lo_nonempty
  exact hi_nonempty
  exact lo_hi_order
